title: Extraction of the SecinH3 from mouse liver
protocol: Weigh 300 mg of mouse liver into a 15 mL centrifugation tube.
Add 1 ml PBS to the mouse liver in the tube.
Add 2 mL chloroform to the mixture.
Homogenize the mouse liver using a polytron.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 30 minutes under agitation.
Centrifuge the sample for 5 minutes at maximum speed.
Transfer the chloroform phase into a fresh centrifugation tube.
Extract the water phase a second time on a shaker with 1.5 mL chloroform for 20 minutes.
Centrifuge the mixture again for 5 minutes at maximum speed.
Combine the chloroform phases and remove the solvent using a SpeedVac.
Dissolve the residue in 100 μL of methanol per 100 mg liver.
Centrifuge the dissolved sample for 5 minutes at 14,000 rpm.
Transfer the liquid into an HPLC glass vial.
Fractionate the sample via HPLC using Nucleosil RP18 material (5 µm, 10x4.0 mm column).
Apply a gradient from 70% water and 30% methanol to 40% water and 60% methanol over 7-15 minutes.
Continue the gradient to 100% methanol from 15-20 minutes.
Collect fractions between 9-12 minutes.
Remove the solvent from collected fractions using a SpeedVac.
Dissolve the residue in 50 µL of methanol.
Fractionate the sample by HPLC, column: MultoHigh RP18 5 µM (125x2.0 mm column).
Apply a gradient from 50% water and 50% methanol to 90% methanol over 25 minutes.
Continue the gradient to 100% methanol at 25.1 minutes.
Analyze the sample by MS, with SecinH3 eluting around 20 minutes.
